title: Core pushout and over-base gluing assertions for dual-number tangent vectors.
statement: theorem tangentVectors_core (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X) : let K := X.residueField x let D := Spec (.of (DualNumber K)) let E := Spec (.of (TrivSqZeroExt K (Fin 2 → K))) let b := X.fromSpecResidueField x let c : Spec K ⟶ D := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom K K K).toRingHom) let q : D ⟶ Spec K := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.inlHom K K)) let r : E ⟶ Spec K := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.inlHom K (Fin 2 → K))) let j : Fin 2 → (D ⟶ E) := fun i => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.map (LinearMap.proj i : (Fin 2 → K) →ₗ[K] K)).toRingHom) let T := {θ : D ⟶ X // c ≫ θ = b ∧ θ ≫ p = q ≫ b ≫ p} IsPushout c c (j 0) (j 1) ∧ (∀ θ₁ θ₂ : T, ∃! Θ : E ⟶ X, j 0 ≫ Θ = θ₁.val ∧ j 1 ≫ Θ = θ₂.val) ∧ (∀ θ₁ θ₂ : T, ∀ Θ : E ⟶ X, j 0 ≫ Θ = θ₁.val → j 1 ≫ Θ = θ₂.val → Θ ≫ p = r ≫ b ≫ p)

proof.text: Specialize existsUnique_dualNumberScheme_extension to n = 2 and the family with entries a and a′. Its compatibility follows from c ≫ a = c ≫ a′. Fin 2 case analysis identifies its coordinate equations with the two desired equations and transfers uniqueness.

The composites c ≫ j 0 and c ≫ j 1 agree because both corresponding ring maps select the constant coefficient. Apply Mathlib IsPushout.mk′ with the extension existence and uniqueness just proved to construct the pushout.
Two tangent vectors restrict to the same residue-field morphism b; apply the two-copy extension property to glue them uniquely.

For each i, j i ≫ r = q by the inclusion and coordinate-projection ring formulas. Thus both restrictions of Θ ≫ p and r ≫ b ≫ p agree, using the given tangent-vector over-base equations. Apply IsPushout.hom_ext.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0B2B; specialization of the existing finite-copy gluing theorem and the pushout universal property
